name: smul_basis_eq_zero
statement: R[X]} (hpq : p • (1 : W'.CoordinateRing) + q • mk W' Y = 0) : p = 0 ∧ q = 0

name: exists_smul_basis_eq
statement: W'.CoordinateRing) : ∃ p q : R[X], p • (1 : W'.CoordinateRing) + q • mk W' Y = x

name: degree_norm_smul_basis
statement: R[X]) : (Algebra.norm R[X] <| p • 1 + q • mk W' Y).degree = max (2 • p.degree) (2 • q.degree + 3)

have_tree.name: hdpq
